description: Guard against a silent cross-browser fallback masking a broken Firefox driver. Every other fixture inherits the default firefox-headless contexts but asserts nothing about the engine that actually carried the context, so a geckodriver Doc Detective can't launch used to degrade to Chrome and still report PASS — which is how the container image shipped with Firefox unusable on every architecture (ADR 01099). Asserting the live user agent makes that fallback a FAIL instead. Where no browser is available at all the context is SKIPPED, as everywhere else.

tests.description: A firefox context must be carried by Firefox itself, not by a fallback engine.

steps.description: Gecko is the only engine whose user agent carries the `Firefox/<version>` token. A fallback to Chrome (or any other engine) fails this assertion rather than passing quietly.
